overview.summary: Alert administrators about unresolved discrepancies from incomplete reconciliation sessions. Integrates into Pending Actions on dashboard, provides daily 5 AM reminders, and marks sessions abandoned after 7 days.

auth_pattern.description: All server actions MUST follow this pattern. RLS handles role-based access. DO NOT create custom auth helpers.

function.name: getReconciliationSessions
function.purpose: Fetches all reconciliation sessions for tenant (list display)

function.name: checkSessionCompletion
function.purpose: Checks if all discrepancies resolved, updates session status to completed

function.name: getSessionAuditEvents
function.purpose: Queries audit log for reconciliation events by session ID

function.name: flagForLater
function.purpose: Creates pending action item when discrepancy flagged for review
function.note: Uses daep_pending_actions table - reference for pending action pattern

audit_logger.existing_event_types:
// Reconciliation Events (existing) | 'reconciliation.session_created' | 'reconciliation.upload_failed' | 'reconciliation.session_completed' | 'reconciliation.mapping_saved' | 'reconciliation.discrepancy_resolved' | 'reconciliation.bulk_accept'
// New for Story 5-10 (add to type union): | 'reconciliation.reminder_sent' | 'reconciliation.session_abandoned'

vercel_cron.note: Daily at 11:00 UTC = 5 AM Central (Texas). DAEP is Texas-focused, so Central Time is the primary target. Simple daily run for all tenants - no timezone-per-tenant complexity.

reconciliation_page.integration_point: Add IncompleteSessions component BEFORE the Upload Section. This shows sessions with unresolved discrepancies at the top.

service_client.description: Cron jobs query across tenants (while keeping data isolated per-tenant). Uses service client that bypasses RLS since cron has no authenticated user.
service_client.tenant_isolation_note: Even though the cron queries all tenants, each notification/action is created with the correct tenant_id. No cross-tenant data mixing.

daily_cron.description: Single daily run at 5 AM Central Time for all tenants. No timezone-per-tenant complexity needed.

role_filtering.description: Only DAEP Admin L1 and L2 roles see reconciliation pending actions.

table.name: daep_reconciliation_sessions
table.columns: id, tenant_id, uploaded_by, file_name, file_url, storage_path, detected_sis, status, total_records, matched_count, discrepancy_count, new_in_sis_count, missing_from_sis_count, upload_date, completed_at, error_message, updated_at
table.note: Add 'abandoned' to status enum via migration

table.name: daep_reconciliation_discrepancies
table.columns: id, tenant_id, session_id, student_id, student_name, incident_number, discrepancy_type, sis_data, daep_data, daep_placement_id, conflicts, resolution, resolution_note, resolved_by, resolved_at

table.name: daep_pending_actions
table.columns: id, tenant_id, created_by, action_type, title, description, priority, reference_type, reference_id, reference_data, completed_at, completed_by

table.name: daep_notifications
table.columns: id, tenant_id, user_id, type, title, message, action_url, read, created_at, read_at
table.note: New table for in-app notifications (create if not exists)

table.name: admin_audit_log
table.columns: id, tenant_id, event_type, actor_id, actor_email, actor_role, target_id, action, details, module, record_subject_name, record_school_id, created_at

function.name: getUnresolvedSessions
function.purpose: Query sessions with unresolved discrepancies for dashboard/reconciliation page
function.note: Uses standard auth pattern - tenant-scoped via RLS

function.name: getReconciliationPendingActions
function.purpose: Format unresolved sessions as pending action items for dashboard
function.note: Role-filtered - only returns for admin roles

function.name: getIncompleteSessionsForNotification
function.purpose: Query sessions >24 hours old still in_review (for cron job)
function.note: Uses service client - queries across all tenants, processes per-tenant

function.name: markAbandonedSessions
function.purpose: Mark sessions as abandoned after 7 days of inactivity
function.note: Called by daily cron job, uses service client

function.name: hasUnacceptedMatches
function.purpose: Check if session has matched records not yet bulk-accepted

function.name: resumeAbandonedSession
function.purpose: Reactivate abandoned session (set status back to in_review)

migrations.migration: Create notifications table with RLS (if not exists)

component_template.name: IncompleteSessions
